result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner is stuck over the already-rendered Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the Popular right now section.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image even though the food photo behind it is fully rendered, making the card look stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading overlay once the image has finished loading so the spinner only appears while content is actually loading.
